label: Unqualified — single wardrobe repair in Nashik
transcript:
Agent: Namaste, thank you for calling Aangan Studio. Before we begin, please note this call is recorded for quality and to help our designers. May I know your name?
Caller: Ramesh.
Agent: Thank you, Ramesh. Which area is your property in?
Caller: I'm in Nashik.
Agent: And what can we help you with?
Caller: One wardrobe door is broken, I need someone to fix the hinge.
Agent: I understand. We mainly work on complete interior projects in Pune, so a single repair may not be something we can take up. I'll note your details, and if the team can help they'll call you back.
Caller: Okay, fine.
Agent: Thank you for calling Aangan Studio.
